periods.time: During Loki Familia's expedition on the 44th floor

name.zh: 艾丝受贝尔越限之战刺激继续追求力量
name.en: Ais Is Stirred by Bell's Limit-Breaking Battle

periods.location: Dungeon 44th floor, Loki Familia expedition front
periods.summary: During Loki Familia's deep-floor expedition, Finn tells Gareth about the Lv.1 boy who defeated a Minotaur on the 9th floor. Riveria confirms Bell's status, and Ais quietly asks how one can break through ability limits. Riveria answers that mortals can reach peaks but not surpass Falna limits, yet Ais draws her sword and returns to battle, still inspired by Bell's back.
periods.cause: Loki Familia witnessed Bell's desperate fight and Bell's impossible apparent limit-breaking remains in Ais's mind.
periods.process: Bete, Tiona, and Tione fight aggressively in the 44th floor while Finn, Gareth, and Riveria discuss the 9th-floor Minotaur scene. Ais, unusually quiet, asks about surpassing limits and then heads toward battle with renewed resolve.
periods.outcome: Ais's competitive and aspirational side awakens further; Bell's fight affects even top-class adventurers.
periods.aftermath: Ais continues pursuing strength as War Princess, with Bell's back burned into her memory.
casualties: Blaze Rock groups defeated by Loki Familia
periods.significance: Shows Bell's influence on Ais and Loki Familia: his impossible fight becomes a mirror for their own approach to limits and risk.
